_comment: Pre-written plans and report text used when the Gemini API is unreachable or has no key. {zone} = the affected zone, {relief} = the least crowded neighbouring zone.

red.headline: Relieve pressure at {zone} now

actions.instruction: Stop all entry into {zone} and announce the hold on staff radio.
Pause the performance and bring house lights up until density drops.
Open the nearest exits and guide people from the edges of {zone} toward {relief}.
Stage at the edge of {zone} and watch for anyone in distress or on the ground.
Hold new arrivals at the entrance until the control room clears {zone}.

red.pa_announcement: For everyone's safety, please take two steps back and give each other space. Staff will guide you toward {relief}.
red.pa_announcement_es: Por su seguridad, den dos pasos hacia atrás y dejen espacio entre ustedes. El personal los guiará hacia {relief}.

yellow.headline: Slow the build-up at {zone}

actions.instruction: Meter entry into {zone} and keep watching the density trend.
Position staff at the entry points of {zone} and redirect new arrivals toward {relief}.
Be ready to pause the show if {zone} keeps filling.
Move one unit closer to {zone} on standby.

yellow.pa_announcement: There is more room in {relief}. Please spread out and keep walkways clear.
yellow.pa_announcement_es: Hay más espacio en {relief}. Por favor, sepárense y mantengan los pasillos despejados.
